title: 第11章 赖账第12章 漫长旅途
content_zh:
在瑞文盖德帝国的长剑触及不到的地方，有着数不清离开帝国的人们建立起来的村庄和小镇，他们躲在人迹罕至的地方，避开帝国的税收，逃离帝国的法律，成为“自由人”
这些城镇坐落在帝国附近的深山、森林或沙漠中，自给自足，过着自己的生活，前提是帝国的军队没有继续扩张，没有找到他们，就像艾什和巴尼眼前的无名小村，没有村长没有书记官，村子里不到百人的村民们，正做着各自的事情。
艾什和巴尼走进村庄，这是艾什第一次自小时候以来第一次看到村庄，在帝都可看不到这么悠闲自然的场景。
村民提着镰刀，在村庄附近开辟出的森林内空地上，在清理着田地的杂草，他们有的懒洋洋的坐在自己茅草和木头凑成的房屋前晒太阳，有的在水井边聚集在一起闲聊，等艾什和巴尼接近后，他们警惕的盯着两个人，面露不善。
不少人对着艾什的头发和眼睛指指点点，小声议论，艾什稍微能听到他们在说什么，无非是白头发红蛇瞳的女人看起来就不是个好东西，应该小心她，说不准是森林里的异族。
艾什倒是对村民的议论不放在心上，她自然的跟着巴尼寻找欠他酬劳的人家，至于其他人的猜忌，艾什觉得无所谓，只要他们不找自己麻烦就好，自己也需要卖掉帐篷帆布，他们爱说什么就说什么吧。
不过，没打算找麻烦的艾什，却被麻烦找上了门，等她和巴尼在村子深处寻找欠酬劳的人家住哪时，八个男人手提斧头，肩扛锄头和草叉气势汹汹的向艾什两人快步走来。
艾什一看那些脸部狰狞的村民们，就知道倒霉的事来了，她停止和巴尼聊天，主动要避开走来的村民，可自己往哪边走，迎面而来的村民们就往哪边堵路，直到艾什左右两边都尝试绕路失败后，她才叹口气站住不动，对一旁的巴尼说道：
“你的村民朋友们看来不是很欢迎我。”
巴尼哈哈一笑，拍着胸脯大步走向村民们，指着其中一个男人笑着说：
“啊~没事的艾什小姐，不要紧张，中间的那位就是我的雇主，我和他说清楚就是.....哦咦！
卡特！
是我啊，你的吟游诗人朋友巴尼！
哎呀，昨天你们走的太快我没跟上迷路了，今天能找回来真是太~好了！”
巴尼和艾什说完就张开双手很是热情的迎向村民，他的语调，或者说语风又恢复到了那种怪里怪气的样子，艾什稍稍低下头，透过头发帘去看四周的情况。
女人们正催促着孩子们回家，年纪大的老人们也纷纷从小躺椅上颤颤巍巍的站起来，躲进了房子内，附近六七个抱着胳膊，往地上吐口水看热闹的，大多都是村里的男人或年轻男女。
艾什明白了，这座小村不是很欢迎她，估计是看到艾什的头发和眼睛颜色，认为艾什是“无恶不作”
的异族了，村民们这么想也不是没有道理，毕竟哪有人类长有蛇瞳呢？
艾什捧着束灵之书，双手环胸站在原地，她看着巴尼和那个叫卡特的村民热情洋溢的说着什么，不过看来卡特并不领情，骂骂咧咧的和周围的村民推搡着巴尼，就像是对待一条狗一样，来回拽着巴尼的衣服，把他推向其他人，再被其他人推走。
皱起眉头的艾什看到巴尼的依旧笑脸相迎不断讨好的样子，似乎看到了在帝都做奴隶的自己，那卑微又被人唾弃的时光，艾什叹口气，望着巴尼被村民推得一屁股坐在自己面前，巴尼回头向艾什尴尬不已的勉强笑了笑。

“啊......呀，艾什小姐，不用在意，卡特先生们颇为激动，错把您当成了异族，有些......责怪我的意思，你稍微等我一下，我和各位先生们好好沟通一下，他们......”
“那边白头发的那女人，我们村不欢迎异族，滚出去！”
巴尼话说了一半就被名为卡特的村民打断，这家伙又瘦又矮，看起来活像是路灯长了四肢在行走，脸色黝黑又牙齿参差不齐，他向艾什语气极其不善和厌恶，艾什哼了声，回答道：
“我不是异族，我是人类。”
“是吗？你的口音里带着帝国人的恶臭，我们这里同样不欢迎帝国人，滚吧，帝国的杂种！”
卡特指着艾什继续骂着，艾什耸耸肩，对地上的巴尼耸耸肩。
“那你自己要钱吧，我在村外等.......”
艾什话音未落，一颗足有拳头大的石头奔着她的面门飞来，艾什赶紧住嘴侧身闪开，她看向石头飞来的方向，卡特身后的村民里，其中一个正蹲下来去捡起另一块石头。
这下艾什火大了起来，我说我要离开你还用石头丢我？我当奴隶的时候都没让人用石头丢过，我现在有了安瑟的赐福，成为了自由人，竟然还被石头丢？
艾什心底那股自己变强后不愿忍耐的性子突然解开了锁链，她火气上涌着把两手摸到腰后，心想我以前又弱又地位低下，现在还能让你们欺负？想都不要想！
小主，这个章节后面还有哦，请点击下一页继续阅读，后面更精彩！
“我说过了，我去村外等吟游诗人，我劝你不要用石头再扔我。”
艾什脸色变得难看至极，她警告着那人，往后退去，可是对方不但对艾什的话嗤之以鼻，以卡特为主的村民们更是大骂着艾什，向她大步前进。
“帝国的狗！
滚出我们的村子！”
“她的眼睛和野兽一样！
她绝不可能是人类！
把她赶出去！”
content_en:
Where the sword of the Ravengard Empire cannot reach, there are countless villages and small towns established by people who left the empire. They hide in inaccessible places, avoid the empire's taxes, escape from the empire's laws, and become "free people"
These towns are located in the deep mountains, forests or deserts near the empire. They are self-sufficient and live their own lives, provided that the empire's army does not continue to expand and find them. Just like the nameless village in front of Ash and Barney, there is no village chief or secretary. The villagers in the village, with less than a hundred people, are doing their own things.
Ash and Barney walked into the village. This was the first time Ash had seen the village since he was a child. Such a leisurely and natural scene could not be seen in the imperial capital.
The villagers were carrying scythes and cleaning the weeds in the open space in the forest near the village. Some of them sat lazily in front of their houses made of thatch and wood to bask in the sun, and some gathered together by the well to chat. When Ash and Barney approached, they stared at the two men warily, with unkind expressions on their faces.
Many people pointed at Ash's hair and eyes and whispered. Ash could hear what they were saying. It was just that the woman with white hair and red snake eyes didn't look like a good person. You should be careful about her. She might be an alien in the forest.
Ash didn't care about the villagers' comments. She naturally followed Barney to find people who owed him compensation. As for other people's suspicions, Ash didn't care. As long as they didn't cause trouble for her, she also needed to sell the tent canvas. They could say whatever they wanted.
However, Ash, who had no intention of looking for trouble, was troubled. When she and Barney were looking for a place to live in the depths of the village, eight men carrying axes, hoes and pitchforks on their shoulders walked towards Ash and the two of them menacingly.
As soon as Ash saw the ferocious-faced villagers, she knew something bad was coming. She stopped chatting with Barney and took the initiative to avoid the approaching villagers. However, wherever she went, the oncoming villagers blocked the road. It wasn't until Ash tried to take detours on both sides and failed, that she sighed and stood still, and said to Barney beside her:
"Your village friends don't seem to welcome me very much."
Barney laughed, patted his chest and strode towards the villagers. He pointed at one of the men and said with a smile:
"Ah~ It's okay, Miss Ash, don't be nervous, the one in the middle is my employer, I'll make it clear to him...oh hey!
Carter!
It's me, your bard friend Barney!
Oops, you walked too fast yesterday and I couldn’t follow you and got lost. It’s great to be able to find you back today! "
After Barney and Ash spoke, he opened his hands and greeted the villagers enthusiastically. His tone, or style of speech, returned to that strange and weird look. Ash lowered his head slightly and looked around through the curtain of hair.
The women were urging the children to go home, and the older people stood up shakily from their small recliners and hid in the house. There were six or seven people nearby with their arms folded and spitting on the ground watching the fun. Most of them were men or young men and women from the village.
Ash understood that this small village did not welcome her very much. She probably saw the color of Ash's hair and eyes and thought that Ash was "all evil"
It is not unreasonable for the villagers to think so. After all, how can any human being have snake eyes?
Ash held the Book of Binding Spirits and stood there with her hands folded on her chest. She watched Barney and the villager named Carter talking passionately, but it seemed that Carter didn't appreciate it. He cursed and pushed Barney with the surrounding villagers, as if he were a dog, pulling Barney's clothes back and forth, pushing him to other people, and then being pushed away by others.
Ash, who frowned, saw Barney's smiling face and continued to please him. It seemed that he had seen Barney working as a slave in the imperial capital.Ash sighed and watched Barney being pushed by the villagers and sitting in front of him. Barney turned back to Ash and smiled awkwardly.
"Ah... ah, Miss Ash, don't worry. Mr. Carter is quite excited and mistakenly regards you as a foreigner. Some... blame me. Please wait for me for a moment, and I will communicate with you gentlemen. They..."
"That woman with white hair over there, foreigners are not welcome in our village, get out!"
Halfway through Barney's words, he was interrupted by a villager named Carter. This guy was thin and short. He looked like a street lamp walking with limbs. His face was dark and his teeth were jagged. He spoke to Ash in an extremely unkind and disgusting tone. Ash snorted and replied:
"I'm not an alien, I'm human."
"Really? Your accent reeks of the Empire. We don't welcome the Empire here either. Go away, you bastard of the Empire!"
Carter pointed at Ash and continued to curse, Ash shrugged and shrugged at Barney on the ground.
"Then you can ask for the money yourself. I'll wait outside the village..."
Before Ash could finish her words, a stone as big as a fist flew toward her face. Ash quickly shut up and stepped aside. She looked in the direction of the flying stone. One of the villagers behind Carter was squatting down to pick up another stone.
Now Ash became very angry. I said I wanted to leave and you still threw stones at me? When I was a slave, I was never stoned. Now that I have been blessed by Anser and become a free man, I am still stoned?
The reluctance in Ash's heart that she was unwilling to endure after becoming stronger was suddenly unchained. She felt her hands behind her waist with anger rising, thinking, I used to be weak and low-status, but now I can still be bullied by you? Don’t even think about it!
My dear, there is more to come after this chapter. Please click on the next page to continue reading. There will be more exciting chapters later!
"As I said, I will wait for the bard outside the village. I advise you not to throw stones at me again."
Ash's face became extremely ugly. She warned the man and stepped back, but the other person not only sneered at Ash's words, but the villagers, mainly Carter, even cursed Ash and strode towards her.
“Imperial dog!
Get out of our village! "
“Her eyes are like those of a wild beast!
There is no way she is human!
Get her out! "
